notes.subject: ימלך עלינו
notes.rationale: Hebrew i tok nating 'Saul i king long mipela' — askim o statmen? KJV 'Shall Saul reign?', YLT em i statmen; not bilong.contex em i askim bilong rausim ol man i no laik Saul.

notes.subject: no
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim 'no' long askim — Hebrew i no gat negesen, contex tasol i givim mining.

notes.subject: ol man i tok long Samuel
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long Samuel — askim bilong bekim ol man i no agri long Saul.

translation: Na ol man i tokim Samuel: Husat i tok, Saul i no ken king long mipela? Givim ⟨em⟩ ol man, na mipela i kilim ol i dai.

tokens.gloss: na mipela i kilim ol i dai
